title: Hex Package Manager Warns of Potential Data Breach
description: A critical vulnerability in the Hex package manager (hex.pm) allowed attackers to execute arbitrary commands on its web servers, potentially exposing sensitive data such as email addresses, password hashes, API keys, sessions, and two-factor authentication secrets. The attack was detected and blocked within minutes, with no evidence of data modification or persistent access. Hex promptly patched the vulnerability and rotated all credentials, logging out all users. Users are advised to change their passwords, reset two-factor authentication, and avoid third-party mirrors until new client versions are released.
